title: Leave
subtitle: Requests, balances and allocations. Leave feeds the attendance engine: days on leave are never marked absent.

fields.halfDayHint: A single day, first or second half.
fields.isPaidHint: Paid days count towards the payroll summary.
fields.treatAsPresentHint: A paid day away from the terminal (site duty). Reports count it with present days, not with leave.
fields.annualAllowanceHint: Shown to employees as their balance in the self-service portal. Leave blank not to track a balance.
fields.requiresApprovalHint: Off: an application is approved at once (recorded as auto-approved).
fields.allowHalfDayHint: Employees can apply for the first or second half of a day.
fields.portalVisibleHint: Offered in the self-service portal. Off: HR records it.
fields.isSpecialHint: Never charged automatically for unexcused days (sick, maternity, Hajj…).
fields.countModeHint: Working days leave weekly offs and holidays free.
fields.applicableGenderHint: A restricted type needs the gender on the employee record.
fields.advanceNoticeDaysHint: Employees are refused below it; HR is only warned.
fields.maxConsecutiveDaysHint: Leave blank for no limit. Employees are refused above it; HR is only warned.
fields.accrualHint: Monthly: the yearly entitlement is earned month by month.
fields.carryForwardMaxDaysHint: Unused days moved into next year at the year close (0 = none).

records.dialogHint: Leave recorded here is approved immediately. Overlapping leave and locked periods are rejected.
records.recalcHint: Attendance for the range is being recalculated.
records.cancelHint: The days are recomputed as normal working days.
records.emptyHint: Record leave here or import it from your HR system.
records.editHint: Pending requests go back to their approvers with the change. Changing decided leave is logged as a correction.
records.resubmitted: The request went back to its approvers.

types.hint: Leave types are referenced by leave records and payroll summaries.
types.dialogHint: The code is used by imports and integrations.
types.deleteHint: Types with existing leave records cannot be deleted — deactivate them instead.
types.emptyHint: Create annual, sick or unpaid leave types to start recording leave.
types.systemHint: The comp-off type is managed by the system: its balance comes from approved comp-off credits. Only its name and colour can change.

decision.noteHint: Shown to the employee with the decision.
decision.noteRequired: A reason is required when rejecting; the employee sees it.
decision.approvalRecorded: Your approval was recorded — waiting for {{names}}
decision.rejectionRecorded: Your rejection was recorded — waiting for {{names}}

accruals.none: All at the start of the year

detail.title: Leave request
detail.noRequest: No approval request: this leave was recorded without one.

thread.title: Conversation
thread.emptyHint: Questions and answers between the employee and the approvers appear here.
thread.replyPlaceholder: Answer the question — your request goes back to the approvers.
thread.replied: Answer sent — the request is back with your approvers

balances.hint: Available of the entitlement for each employee (allocations, carry-forward, accrual, taken and pending leave).
balances.emptyHint: Balances appear once employees and leave types exist.

allocations.hint: Allocation rows are the entitlement of each employee per leave type and year. Balances are computed from them.
allocations.dialogHint: The allocation for {{year}}. Carried-forward days can expire; an adjustment can be negative.
allocations.carriedForwardHint: Days brought from the previous year.
allocations.openingHint: Days brought in from a previous system.
allocations.adjustmentHint: A manual correction (negative to take days away).
allocations.emptyHint: Create them from each type's yearly allowance, or add them one by one.
allocations.generateHint: Every active employee gets a row per type with a yearly allowance, prorated for joiners. Existing rows are never changed.
allocations.closeHint: Unused days of types that carry forward move into {{to}}, capped by each type and with its expiry. Running it again changes nothing.

calendar.emptyHint: Approved and pending leave of the people you can see appears here.
calendar.truncated: Only the first 300 employees with leave this month are shown. Narrow it down by branch.

team.title: Team leave
team.empty: No upcoming leave in your team

apply.editHint: Your approvers see the change and decide again.
apply.editAnswers: Saving the change answers the approver's question: the request goes back to them.
apply.resubmitted: It went back to your approvers.
apply.autoApproved: Leave approved — this type needs no approval
apply.noHalfDay: {{type}} cannot be taken as a half day.

issues.halfDay: {{type}} cannot be taken as a half day.
issues.notice_one: {{type}} needs {{count}} day's notice — the earliest start date is {{date}}.
issues.notice_other: {{type}} needs {{count}} days' notice — the earliest start date is {{date}}.
issues.maxConsecutive_one: {{type}} allows at most {{count}} day per request.
issues.maxConsecutive_other: {{type}} allows at most {{count}} days per request.
issues.overlap: You already have {{type}} from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{status}}): one leave per date. Change or withdraw it first.

portal.carriedExpiring: Includes {{days}} days carried forward, usable until {{date}}
portal.withdrawHint: Your approvers see why. Approved leave can only be cancelled by HR.

compOff.title: Comp-off
compOff.after: {{days}} comp-off days left after this request.
compOff.useHint: Take days off against your comp-off credits. The earliest-expiring credits are used first, when the request is approved.
compOff.empty: No comp-off credits yet. Worked on a weekly off day or a holiday? Request one.
compOff.noRecord: No attendance record for this day
compOff.requestHint: For work on a weekly off day or a holiday: {{full}} hours earn a day, {{half}} hours half a day. Approved credits can be used for {{days}} days.
compOff.willEarn: Earns {{days}} day of comp-off once approved.
compOff.belowHalf: Below half a day: at least {{hours}} hours are needed.
compOff.requested: Comp-off requested. Your approver has been notified.

reasons.future: Comp-off is earned for a day already worked; this date is in the future.
reasons.before_joining: This date is before your joining date.
reasons.after_exit: This date is after your exit date.
reasons.working_day: This is a working day: comp-off is earned for work on a weekly off day or a holiday.
reasons.expired: A credit for this date would already have expired.
reasons.already_requested: You already requested comp-off for this date.

settings.title: Leave
settings.compOffExpiryDaysHint: Counted from the day worked. Default 90.
settings.compOffThresholds: The hours that earn a full or half comp-off day follow Settings → Attendance → full-day hours.
